## Research interests {.section-title}

- Iberoromance (Pronominal) Syntax
- Differential object marking
- Interface phenomena
- Second Language Acquisition
- Statistic Data Modelling
- Empirical Methods: Experimental and Corpus Linguistics
- Psycholinguistics
- NLP and Machine Learning

## Personal interests

Outside of research, I enjoy photography and travelling, especially when it gives me the chance to engage with new languages and cultures. I like spending time outdoors hiking, running, or road biking, and in colder months I regularly go swimming, bouldering and climbing.
